text.body:
purā kadācit kapisārvabhaumaḥ kaścitsamāhūya janān svakīyān | pravartya sammelanamātmanīnāmuvāca vācaṃ vadatāṃ vareṇyaḥ || 1 ||
jñātaṃ hi vo vānaravaṃśavṛddhāḥ prāñco yadasmatkulajā mahāntaḥ | śauryeṇa vīryeṇa ca vidyayā ca lokatraye'pi prathitā babhūvuḥ || 2 ||
priyopalambhāya vṛtaḥ sahāyo yaḥ kosalendrasya kumārakeṇa | kasyātra loke vidito na jantoḥ sugrīvanāmā sa kapipravīraḥ || 3 ||
kailāsakampaprathitaprabhāvaṃ laṅkeśvaraṃ yaḥ krimivaccakarṣa | nilīya viddho raghunandanena kasmin kule'jāyata saiṣa vālī ||4 ||
udanvadullaṅghanalabdhavarṇo laṅkāpurīdāhalasatpratāpaḥ | śrīmān navavyākaraṇapravīṇo jajñe hanūmān sa ca kutra vaṃśe || 5 ||
neibandhito'bdhau raghupuṅgavena yasyākhyayā seturiha prasiddhaḥ | ācaḍhvamāho kapivaṃśavṛddhāḥ so'yaṃ nalaḥ kutra babhūva vaṃśe || 6 ||
kimadya sarvairgaṇitairmahadbhirye naḥ kulālaṃkṛtayo babhūvuḥ | vivakṣitaṃ kiñcididaṃ vadāmi vidhāya karṇe vimṛśantu santaḥ || 7 ||
kintāvadasmāsu na vidyate yanmanuṣyajāteravarā bhavema | kiṃvā manuṣyeṣyadhika cakāsti yataḥ prakṛṣyeta manuṣyavargaḥ || 8 ||
itīrayitvā giramarthayuktāṃ tūṣṇīṃ bhavan vānaravāvadūkaḥ | vāgmitvadarpoddhatadhīramandaṃ sabhāṃ samantāt kṣaṇamāluloke || 9 ||
svotkarṣavācā vikasanmukhānāṃ plavaṅgamānāṃ vividhāṅgahāraiḥ || protsāhito'sau plavagādhirājaḥ prītaḥ punardhīramuvāca vācam || 10 ||
tadadya mānyāḥ paricintayadhvaṃ dharmaṣu śākhairupadarśiteṣu | manuṣyavargasya yathā'dhikārastathā kimasmatkulajasya na syāt || 11 ||
cirapralīno'pi sa sampradāyo nūnaṃ bhavadbhiḥ paripālanīyaḥ | dharmavyapāye hi mṛgatvavādaḥ pravārtito'smāsu bhavennirūḍhaḥ || 12 ||
tātkālikaṃ kleśamataḥ sahadbhirnidhīyatāṃ dhīḥ sthiradharmamārge | ekādaśī śvo bhavitā tadānī mupoṣya dharme prathamaṃ kurudhvam || 13 ||
śākhāmṛgāṇāmiti cakravartī niṣicya karṇeṣvamṛtaṃ kapīnām | santoṣacihnairbahudhopalakṣaisteṣāṃ prahṛṣyan virato babhūva | 14 |
kīckārasāndrāṃ plutabhedadṛśyāṃ tasyārhaṇāṃ premamayīṃ pravācaḥ | kṛtvopavāse kṛtaniścayāste mudā yayurmānuṣasāmyahṛṣṭāḥ || 15 ||
atha prabhāte kila jāgāritvā nadījalasnānapavitratāṅgāḥ | nidhāya rāmaṃ hṛdi te'bhirāmaṃ saṅkalpayāmāsurupoṣaṇāya | 16 |
atha kṣaṇārdhaṃ nibhṛtaṃ sthitānāṃ parasparaprekṣaṇatatparāṇām | hṛdīva gātre'pi babhūva laulyaṃ prabhuḥ svabhāvaṃ vyativartituṃ kaḥ || 17 |
vidhāya jṛmbhāṃ vyavadhūya hastaṃ prasārya pādaṃ parivartya gātram | ācuṃbya pucnchāgramasoḍhakaṇḍūrante kapiḥ ko'pi vibheda maunam || 18 ||
asaṃśayaṃ samprati pālanīyaṃ vrataṃ mahāpuṇyamidaṃ mahāntaḥ | tathā'pi jambūdrumamūlabhājāṃ śvaḥ pāraṇā naḥ mukareti bhāti || 19 |
ityevamuktaṃ svaguṇānurūpaṃ kīśena tena pratimodamānāḥ | sthirāsanakleśavināśatoṣāt kīśāḥ pare tulyamiti praṇeduḥ || 20 ||
tathā'stu ko doṣa iha sthitāścedvratopavāsaśramapīḍitāṅgāḥ | vṛkṣān prati prātaritaḥ prayātuṃ prāyeṇa śaktā na vayaṃ bhavema || 21 ||
itthaṃ viniścitya taṭāttaṭinyāḥ svacchandamutplutya viceṣṭamānāḥ | āsādya jambūdrumamūladeśamābadhya paṅktiṃ harayo niṣeduḥ || 22 ||
tathā sthitāste kṣaṇikānubaddhairudvīkṣaṇairviṣvagavakṣaṇaiśca | kaṇḍūyanaiśśīghratamaiśca kāṃścit kṣaṇān kathañcit kṣapayāṃbabhūvuḥ || 23 ||
athotthitaḥ kaścidaluptadhairyaḥ kapiḥ kapīndrān kathayāmbabhūva | āruhya vṛkṣaṃ yadi saṃviśema kā naḥ kṣatistatra bhaviṣyatīti || 24 ||
vratasya hānirnahi kācidasti tatretyurīkṛtya tadapyamīdrāk | āruhya vṛkṣaṃ vitatāsu tasthuḥ śākhāsu tasya vratinaḥ kapīndrāḥ || 25 ||
tatraikato joṣamavāsthitānāṃ nirbandhajātadviguṇaśramāṇām| abhakṣaṇadhyānanirantarāṇāṃ kṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇo'dṛśyata kalpadīrghaḥ || 26 ||
vāteritābhyo dumaśākhikābhyaḥ saśabdapātīni rasolbaṇāni | phalāni dṛśyāni nirīkṣya niryaddantodakānāṃ kṣubhitaṃ mano'bhūt || 27||
phalānupātisvamanoratheṣu hrīyantṛṇānmaunamabhañjayatsu | | sarveṣu kaścit pratilabhya dhairyaṃ sarvāśayaṃ svāśayavajjagāda || 28 ||
prakalpitā sarvavidā vidhātrā kapolayorasti hi bhastrikā naḥ | tāṃ pūrayemādya phalairaduṣṭairnāstāṃ phalānveṣaṇasaṅkaṭaṃ śvaḥ || 29 ||
tathetyathotplutya haripravīrāḥ śākhopaśākhāsu paribhramantaḥ | phalairaśuṣkaiḥ paripākaramyairapūrayannānanakandarāṇi|| 30 ||
tataḥ paraṃ yat karaṇīyamatra na kiñcidanyonyanivedyamāsīt | tasmāccarantaḥ kapayo yathecchaṃ jahrurlikhantīṃ kila lekhanīṃ naḥ || 35 |
